page_title: HOF 0-1 WOL | Hoffenheim v Wolfsburg 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the right post, but Kamil Grabara is prepared and dives to thwart him.
90+4' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.

90+3' Erencan Yardimci (Hoffenheim) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Kamil Grabara, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is able to continue to play.
90+1' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The game is interrupted now, Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
89' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Ralph Hasenhuttl decides to make a substitution. Joakim Maehle will be replaced by Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg).
89' Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kilian Fischer.
88' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
88' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
86' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
86' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' The shots on goal statistics – 0:3.

79' Unbelievable miss! Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
78' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
77' The ball is cleared after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

72' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
70' Christian Dingert blows his whistle. Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.

57' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

33' Christian Dingert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
31' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

29' The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.

25' Total attempts – 1:1.

9' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.

8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
